description: This file defines the IconDefinitionInterface interface for icon definitions within Drupal's theme system, including methods for creating, retrieving, and manipulating icon data.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an icon definition with specified parameters such as pack ID, icon ID, template, source, group, and additional data.

methods.name: createIconId
methods.description: Generates a full icon ID from pack ID and icon ID.

methods.name: getIconDataFromId
methods.description: Retrieves icon pack and icon IDs from a full icon ID.

methods.name: getRenderable
methods.description: Returns a renderable array for the icon, given its full ID and optional settings.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the human-readable label of the icon.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the full icon ID in the format pack_id:icon_id.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Returns the icon source URL or path.

methods.name: getPackLabel
methods.description: Returns the icon pack label as TranslatableMarkup.

methods.name: getAllData
methods.description: Returns all icon data, injected by extractors.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns specific icon data by key.
